reviews.title: Best commuter cup in Dhaka
reviews.text: The ceramic interior doesn't retain coffee smell like cheap steel mugs do. The spill-proof lid actually works during rickshaw rides in Gulshan traffic. 10/10!

reviews.title: Looks like an upscale café cup
reviews.text: The double wall gives an illusion that the latte is floating in air. Stays pleasantly warm and outside stays completely cool. Absolutely love it!

reviews.title: Substantial weight and luxurious matte glaze
reviews.text: Feels sturdy and heavy in hand. The matte finish feels very premium and looks incredible on my desk setup. Arrived in Dhaka within 24 hours safely packaged.

reviews.title: Everyone in my office asks about this mug!
reviews.text: The 'cute but overthinker' print is crisp and high quality. Didn't fade after dozens of dishwasher cycles. Brings a smile to my face every morning.

reviews.title: Excellent thermal shock resistance
reviews.text: Poured boiling water directly into the cold glass without any issue. Extremely clear borosilicate and comfortable glass handle.

reviews.title: Elegant pastel tones for afternoon tea
reviews.text: The porcelain is feather light yet sturdy. The pastel glaze and delicate rim give it an authentic boutique aesthetic.

reviews.title: Pure artisan craftsmanship
reviews.text: You can feel the handmade organic textures. Holds heat remarkably well while reading my book in the evening.
